inputs.input: What files does the Dharma Duel project scaffold include?

cases.output:
The Dharma Duel project scaffold includes the following files:

main.py - entry point, starts the game loop
game.py - game logic, turn management, battle pile
card.py - Card class, loads cards from JSON
ui.py - Pygame rendering, menus, card display
requirements.txt - just pygame

Data:
data/cards.json - all 40 card records

Documentation:
README.md - setup and overview
QUICKSTART.md - 3-step quick start
docs/cards.md - how to add/modify cards

The project uses an iterative v1.0 prototype approach, keeping the scope minimal and playable before adding features.

inputs.input: What characters are included in the Dharma Duel card game?

cases.output:
The Dharma Duel card game includes 40 legendary Buddhist figures:

Chief Disciples: Sariputta, Maha Moggallana
Foremost Disciples: Maha Kassapa, Ananda, Anuruddha, Upali, Angulimala, Channa, Rahula, Kisa Gotami, Anna Kondanna
Family: Siddhartha, Suddhodana, Queen Maya, Mahapajapati, Yasodhara, Devadatta, Nanda
Royal Patrons: King Bimbisara, King Pasenadi
The Awakened One: Buddha
Forces of Mara: Mara and His Retinue, Mara's Daughters, Mara's Army, Devaputra Mara
And many more including Visakha, Khema, Uppalavanna, Anathapindika, Emperor Ashoka, Sujata, Amrapali, Vessantara, Sakka, Brahma Sahampati, Mucalinda Naga.
